## Checklist

- [ ] The change preserves accepted architectural invariants or updates an ADR.
- [ ] Tests/fixtures prove the intended path executed.
- [ ] Output is deterministic where required.
- [ ] No fuzzy/semantic candidate is presented as proven evidence.
- [ ] Documentation routing is updated.
- [ ] Third-party provenance and license are recorded when applicable.
